verdict.rationale: Parahelp offers guardrails that gate individual tool actions behind approval (per-amount thresholds, Slack approve/deny) and role-based access across the product, which are adjacent least-privilege controls, but there is no evidence of actually issuing scoped/limited API credentials or keys specifically for agent use — API setup documented (e.g., Pylon token) is Parahelp receiving full third-party credentials, not the platform generating scoped tokens for the agent. missing for 10: explicit scoped/limited API key or token issuance mechanism, credential scope configuration UI, documentation of least-privilege agent authentication design.
